title: After The Burial Premiere "Collapse"
contentHtml:
After The Burial have released “Collapse,” the second single off Dig Deep, leaving fans a little bit of a placeholder until the record releases this month on February 19. Dig Deep is the last record After The Burial recorded with guitarist Justin Lowe before he passed away late last year due to an apparent drug overdose. “Collapse” switches the sound up from the last single released the third quarter of 2015, titled “Lost in the Static.”

You can catch After The Burial on the Sumerian Records 10th Anniversary Tour which takes off in Minneapolis, Minnesota at Skyway Theater the day Dig Deep is scheduled for release, and will go all across the country with Veil of Maya, Born of Osiris, and Erra. You can stream “Collapse” today over on YouTube and iTunes through preorder.

​
